reviews.text:
A wonderful team for my darling cat. They were very reassuring.
They truly love animals; they helped me when I found a cat in distress in the street and went above and beyond to find its owner!
An excellent professional, passionate about his work, and very compassionate! He provided excellent care for my pet from the beginning to the end of his very long life! Thank you, Doctor!
A top-notch vet, incredibly kind and highly professional. I highly recommend him.
He's great!
Exceptionally skilled and kind. The operation on our cat, who had been hit by a car, seemed impossible, but he operated on her and now she's running around like a rabbit.
Great practice, the team is lovely and very welcoming.

A caring and compassionate veterinary clinic where the animal is king!

I highly recommend it.
An excellence in his profession.

Mr. Kirchner is undoubtedly one of the best veterinarians in Lyon, by far.

My grandparents have been going to Mr. Kirchner since he opened his clinic. He has always been kind and attentive, and we are truly grateful for all these years for the care and attention he has given our dogs. He has always been there for us after the passing of our dogs.

Excellent veterinarian.
The assistants are excellent too.
Our dog Uno loves going there and feels completely at ease.

Fantastic vet! Dr. Kirchner is a kind and caring man with his patients, an excellent doctor, and very good at explaining things to his patients' parents. I don't have the emotional capacity to trust everyone when it comes to my dog, but Dr. Kirchner has shown me on several occasions that he is extremely attentive to my dog, and although we don't always agree on everything, I can entrust him with my pet's health without hesitation, even if my dog ​​is never very keen on visiting him 😏

Dear Solène,
We wanted to thank you for the support you offered us during Java's final moments. Your gentleness, patience, and great humanity allowed us to experience this incredibly difficult time with greater peace of mind. You surrounded Java with respect and kindness until the very end, and this will remain a comforting memory for us during this ordeal.

We were deeply touched by your thoughtful words and the sensitivity with which you guided us through each step.
Thanks to you, Java passed away peacefully, and we will cherish the feeling that we made this decision under the best possible circumstances.

Thank you to you and Suzon as well for your professionalism and, above all, the immense compassion you showed.

With our deepest gratitude,
Florence and Léa
An exceptional veterinarian, attentive and available. Thank you!

Best vet in the 6th arrondissement, always smiling, always offering great advice, and above all, an incredible welcome from these competent and incredibly kind professionals!
My two cats are patients there and always receive the best possible care! I recommend them a thousand times over!

Thank you to the entire team at the clinic, the doctors, and the veterinary assistants, for caring for our dog Kir all these years until the very end, despite his many health issues. He always received the best possible care. We are incredibly grateful; it was always a pleasure for Kir to visit you. The image of the veterinarian was anything but negative for him thanks to the caring environment you provided. We will know exactly where to go for our future companions.
Thank you again.

I recently took my cat, a 10-year-old Sphynx with heart problems, in for a dental cleaning requiring general anesthesia—a procedure that, I confess, made me quite emotional. However, everything went perfectly! I am deeply grateful to the entire team: not only the veterinarian, but also the assistant, who was attentive, gentle, and fully committed. Thank you for your professionalism, kindness, and patience!
Extremely grateful to Dr. Kirchner and the entire team at the practice for their empathy, kindness, and compassion! Thank you so much 🙏 …

My 14-year-old Bichon Frise has been seen at this clinic by Dr. Barsamian since we moved to Lyon. In addition to being a competent and attentive professional, she provides genuine care tailored to the age and health of our four-legged friends, without unnecessary unnecessary tests. I also want to highlight the responsiveness of the very kind veterinary assistant in scheduling an appointment quickly in case of an emergency. 😊 I highly recommend her.

Very professional with a humane and compassionate approach.

I come for my whippet's health check-ups and, more recently, for my cat's final journey at the age of 18.

The doctor and his wife support us with kindness and empathy during these difficult times, and I truly appreciated it.

One of the best clinics I have been to, they are extremely caring and attentive to our pets, who are always getting into trouble. When our dog fell very sick they gave us every option and advice, and supported us when we needed to make tough decisions. Highly recommended.
This vet is the best vet in the world. We’ve taken our old beagle to this vet and each time she gets incredible care. The vet is so warm and gentle with her, and never makes us feel rushed.

Bad experience.

It seems that other people have only had good experiences, but that wasn't my case.
I went there for my two-and-a-half-year-old dog, who was in excellent health, simply for a minor spaying procedure. I dropped her off at 8:45 a.m., everything was fine, she was very excited, probably from the smell of the other animals and the unfamiliar environment, because when I called, they didn't offer me any pre-visit or tests; they simply told me I would have to leave my daughter there for the day. At 9:20 a.m., I received a call telling me I had to come quickly; my dog ​​had died. She was only there for 30 minutes; he had already given her two injections in her anus before I left, and when I went back, he told me she had died at the end of the operation and that he had even stitched her up. In 30 minutes, he administered two injections, anesthetized, and completed the operation on a young pug, less than three years old, whom he had never seen before, without running any tests, checking his heart, or waiting for the excitement and stress to subside before even administering the anesthetic. He didn't take care of my dog, whom I had entrusted to him. He never bothered to call us to see how we were, to express his feelings afterward, or to compensate us for our dog's death. He did, however, admit his mistake, saying he should have run tests and that he accepted responsibility. Meanwhile, my dog, whom I loved like a member of the family and who was still just a puppy, died for nothing, and in my opinion, it was his negligence that killed her. So no, I would not recommend this veterinarian, whom I cannot forgive for treating me like a file on an assembly line and who gave me back a box of ashes.

The entire team at the clinic provides excellent care.

Both our dogs are now treated here, one of them for nine years.
My other dog, who arrived more recently, is a rescue dog who can be reactive due to fear of humans. From her first appointment to all subsequent ones, the whole team ensured her treatment was gentle and went as smoothly as possible, taking the necessary time. They offered us solutions that are helping her progress. We hadn't experienced this level of service at other clinics.
They demonstrate true expertise in both medical care and their relationship with the animals, as well as in the administrative support.

About eight years ago, on a cold winter morning, I rescued a stray kitten that was drowning in the water retention basin of a recycling center. As it struggled to survive, I decided to dive in. I called this clinic (which was my vet's office), and they offered to come directly to me. After warming and drying the kitten, I brought it in. The doctor and his team immediately took charge of the kitten, cleaning it thoroughly—twice, in fact—because it was riddled with parasites. The doctor also tried to place the kitten with several families that afternoon, but it was difficult because it was a feral cat. I picked it up the next morning and placed it with my best friend's parents, where it now lives like a king in the countryside with a dog who is its best friend. I went back four years ago, and this cat gave me a welcome like its owners had never seen. He hadn't forgotten... I just wanted to say a huge thank you to the doctor and his team for doing everything for the animal. He made himself available, didn't charge me anything, and gave him a wonderful second chance. Thank you again! This doctor is incredibly kind and highly competent; I sincerely recommend him.

Dr. Kirchner is very competent and caring. He guided us through the process of treating our new puppy and took excellent care of all the issues she experienced, with great attention and follow-up. The staff is also very helpful and kind. I highly recommend this veterinarian!
A veterinary practice with exceptional attentiveness. Dr. Kirchner remembers all his patients and welcomes their owners with rare empathy.

Extremely competent. Literally saved my cat: kudos for the diagnosis and the medication which works perfectly.
Warm contact with the whole team.

What I wrote 5 years ago: "A veterinarian with a heart of gold, extremely competent, who loves the animals he cares for, full of good, easy-to-implement advice, both for treatment and training. We go to him for treatment, we go back for the pleasure of it..." still as exceptional as ever

This vet's team is fantastic. Attentive and honest, they always provide only the necessary care.
You can go there with complete confidence.
Attentive and friendly :)
Excellent veterinary practice.
